# hpe_morpheus_library_spec_template (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Library Spec Template resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_library_spec_template" "example" {
  name    = "Kubernetes Deployment"
  type    = "kubernetes"
  source  = "local"
  content = file("/path-to-file")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the spec template.
- `type` (String) The type of the spec template (terraform, kubernetes, helm, cloudformation, arm).

### Optional

- `content` (String) The content of the spec template.
- `external_id` (String) The external ID of the spec template.
- `source` (String) The source type (local, repository, url).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the spec template.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_library_spec_template.example 123
```
